notes.title: New Event《Veil of Mercy: Sister's Salvation》& v2.1.0 Updates
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IJk6bUZ.gif[/img]

In “Veil of Mercy: Sister’s Salvation,” Marie Von Eisenberg, a determined and resolute heroine, enters a corrupted church to confront Azerjael, a fearsome demon performing dark rituals. As Azerjael unleashes a barrage of dark energy, Marie invokes the power from her pact with a tentacle demon, gaining strength and resolve to cleanse the land of corruption. Vowing to purify every tainted place, Marie battles Azerjael and his minions, seeking to restore peace and sanctity wherever she goes.

[h1]《Veil of Mercy: Sister's Salvation》[/h1]

Help Marie defeat Azerjael and his minions by cleansing the corrupted rooms and earning coins. These coins can be used to unlock new character and items from the Event Shop, aiding Marie in her quest to purify the land. Overcome various challenges, purify the tainted grounds, and collect valuable rewards as you progress through the event.

Required tavern level [u][b]3[/b][/u] to trigger this event.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uL1rFLe.gif[/img]
[i](Tap Space on the weakness symbol on the chanting bar to attack Azerdjael)[/i]

[h2] Rewards [/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8MtsVJ8.gif[/img]

[h3][b]1. New Character: Marie Von Eisenberg[/b][/h3]
[h3]Artist: dishwasher1910[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0lufamt.gif[/img]
[i](Exchange 100 Obols for 10x shards to summon Marie.)[/i]

[b]Once you summon Marie:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gL5aoRT.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Unlock Marie's Gallery immediately in the Gallery Menu.
[*] Marie's shards will be available from treasure chests and the lucky wheel.
[*] Marie can be hired from the shop.
[*] Has a chance to summon for her Shiny version.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eVILxFd.gif[/img]

[h3][b]2. Pet: Mini Tentacle[/b][/h3]
[i]Mini self-clone of Zagath[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xYjU9mP.png[/img]

It will be wandering around the tavern and collect any chest on the road.

[h3][b]3. New Items[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CGrto6Z.png[/img]

And other rewards for completing the event.

Players can now upgrade a character's stars to a maximum of 5 stars.
Trained stars will be indicated with different color.
The [b]Upgrade Star[/b] feature is now available in the training room.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XUod4yr.gif[/img]

notes.title: 《Love Tavern》 Official Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nAKEEIt.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

The wait is over, and we're thrilled to announce that Love Tavern is now officially available! We appreciate your patience and support throughout this journey. Without further ado, let's dive into the exciting new features awaiting you in this release:

[h2]1. Additional Tavern Spaces[/h2]
Expand and personalize your tavern with more rows and columns! Now you have even more space to showcase your creativity and efficiently allocate resources to create the ultimate haven for your customers.

[h2]2. New NPC Quest Line[/h2]
Embark on a captivating quest line featuring Ren, Yui, Yumi, Georgia, Adifaah, and Goddess Naomi. Completing these quests not only unlocks a gallery of characters but also grants you access to various features and buffs. Once a quest is conquered, you have the opportunity to hire these fantastic NPCs to enhance your tavern.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SUdyw8N.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/lX67VVs.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/UpqSj9Z.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MyZKMIZ.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/sE9gdEj.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/X1vi2xK.gif[/img]

[h2]3. New Customers Quest[/h2]
Discover additional quests to unlock special customers with unique traits and cool rewards. Engage with these quests to bring new faces to your tavern and reap the benefits of their presence.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JJcpsvh.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/WGaXDC2.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/fJE1VHa.gif[/img]

[h2]4. Auto-cooking[/h2]
Unleash the power of automation by assigning recipes for automatic cooking! This feature, unlocked through the NPC quest line, allows you to streamline your restaurant operations and focus on other aspects of managing your bustling tavern.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oSXMfTT.gif[/img]

[h2]5. Expedition[/h2]
Also unlocked through the NPC quest line, the Expedition feature lets you send staff on automatic hunting missions. Sit back and relax as your skilled adventurers bring back valuable resources from their expeditions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3vqK850.gif[/img]

[h2]6. Training and Reroll Rework[/h2]
Revamped training mechanics allow you to target specific talent training instead of relying on randomness. Rerolling now resets all levels and focuses all talent points into one randomly selected talent. Take a chance to earn Shiny Characters with each re-roll.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QSYLpKm.png[/img]

[h2]7. New 3-stars and 4-stars staff[/h2]
There should be a lot of unforgettable characters as you dig into your staff's stories. Now you can unlock them as additional staff by earning shards from customer quests or the Fortune Wheel. Once unlocked, these talented individuals will be available for hire in the shop, adding a new dimension to your tavern management strategy.. (Please note: these new staff will not have stories and galleries)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bs3mFdV.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/wPzsslZ.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/2RTZeKi.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/n1cWINl.gif[/img]

[h2]8. Fortune Wheel[/h2]
Introducing the Fortune Wheel! Spend tickets to spin the lucky wheel and collect shards of new characters. Test your luck and expand your staff roster with this exciting addition to Love Tavern.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1Nvz9dh.gif[/img]

[h2]9. Shiny Character[/h2]
Hiring staff using Shards or Reroll now carries the chance to unlock special Shiny Characters. Customize their colors to add a personal touch and make your tavern truly unique.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9OHZtuR.gif[/img]

Thank you for your unwavering support and love for Love Tavern. We hope you thoroughly enjoy these new features and enhancements. Dive in, build the tavern of your dreams, and create unforgettable moments with your customers!

Cheers to endless adventures and joyous moments in Love Tavern!

Secret Labo Team

notes.title: Love Tavern Upcoming Q4 Release - Developer Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are thrilled to announce that we've been hard at work on the upcoming release version of Love Tavern, and we can't wait to share with you the exciting changes and improvements we've been working on. Get ready for an even more immersive and enjoyable gaming experience!

Here's a sneak peek at what's coming in the [b]Love Tavern[/b] Release Version:

[h2]1. Gameplay Adjustment[/h2] 

We understand the importance of maintaining a balanced and challenging gameplay experience for both our veteran players and newcomers. While the core gameplay remains intact, we've made significant adjustments to ensure a more balanced and enjoyable gameplay. We recommend starting a new save in the release version to fully embrace these changes.

[h2]2. New NPC Quest Line:[/h2] 

Embark on a thrilling new journey with our brand-new NPC quest line. Completing these quests will unlock a host of exciting features and rewards that will enhance your Love Tavern experience. Check out this exclusive screenshot:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yFKjadX.png[/img]

[h2]3. New NPC Gallery[/h2]

Getting [b]6 new NPC Gallery items[/b] after completing their questlines:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/36sjWnV.png[/img]

[h2]4. New Types of Special Customers:[/h2] 

Prepare to meet a diverse range of special customers who will grace your tavern. To unlock them, you'll need to undertake engaging quests. Once unlocked, these special customers will bring fresh challenges and bountiful rewards to your establishment. Here's a glimpse of a few of our new customers: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hNwCdRo.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/ufnlX3H.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/cikOyB2.gif[/img]

[h2]5. Automate Cooking:[/h2] 

Say goodbye to the hassle of manual cooking! We're introducing a brand-new automation feature that will streamline your cooking process and make managing your tavern even more efficient. Check out this automation in action: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oSXMfTT.gif[/img]

[h2]6. Automate Hunting - Expedition:[/h2] 

Explore the wild and embark on thrilling expeditions to gather valuable resources. With the new automation feature for hunting and expeditions, you can focus on other aspects of managing your tavern while your adventurers do the hard work for you. Witness the excitement of expedition automation: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3vqK850.gif[/img]


[h2]7. Additional Row and Column Expansion:[/h2] 

As your tavern grows, so does your need for space. We're expanding the playing field with additional rows and columns, giving you more room to create the tavern of your dreams.

[b]And more performance improvement and bug fixes.[/b]

Get ready for a whole new level of Love Tavern fun and excitement! We can't wait for you to experience all these incredible updates firsthand. Stay tuned for the official release date, and in the meantime, share your excitement with fellow tavern owners and gamers.

Thank you for your continued support and love for [b]Love Tavern[/b]. We look forward to seeing you in the release version!

Warm regards,
Secret Labo

notes.title: Love Tavern Monthly Update – June 2021
notes.notes:
Hi all, here is the June update of Love Tavern.
View full images article at: [url=http://secretlabo.net/2021/06/30/love-tavern-monthly-update-june-2021/]June Update[/url]

We are very thankful for all your feedbacks and supports on our Demo release. Although we have planned to release Early Access in June, due to the Summer Sale event, we have postponed it to July, after one Summer Sale 1 to 2 weeks. We will have a small close-beta test prior to EA release, check it out in our new [url=https://discord.gg/KDxQzsU2]Discord Community Group[/url].

[h1]Characters[/h1]
There are 9 playable girls with 6 girls with completed stories and animation scenes (abbr. as H-Scenes) in the Early Access and more to come in the final release.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RT7ZDFO.png[/img]

You can also get equipment throughout the game and equip your girls with them to increase their talent stats.

[h1]Tavern’s Room Building[/h1]
We have 13 types of rooms for the building systems. They all have distinctive functions and designs. There is also a combination function when you place 2 small rooms alongside each other, they will merge into a larger room with a nicer design with some improved features. We are also planning to add more types of room to make the game more fun to play, if you have any ideas or suggestions, leave us a comment in our [url=https://discord.gg/5vaWkHrM]Discord Community[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/of6XrBu.gif[/img]

[h1]Game Mechanics[/h1]
Apart from cooking and hunting as you played in the demo, now you have to handle cleaning and clinic when the Tavern reaches a higher rank. In addition, resources management also will need to be taking into account.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i59AX8m.gif[/img]

[h1]Language Support[/h1]
At the moment, we plan to support 5 languages: English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Russian and Thai. Looking for beta testers to help us verify the quality of these translations, leave us a message if you are interested in our [url=https://discord.gg/KDxQzsU2]Discord Community[/url].

We would like to tell you more, but we think it’s better for you to experience them during the game. See you at the Early Access Release. Cheers!

notes.title: Love Tavern Monthly Update – February 2021
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the first post of our monthly Love Tavern updates.

First, we would like to show our appreciation for your interest in Love Tavern and our other games. We apologize for the delay in posting an update of Love Tavern because we are focusing on developing the core features of the game. However, we’ve managed to build up a website to record down what we have done so far. Make sure to check it out at [url=http://secretlabo.net]http://secretlabo.net[/url]

[h2]Characters[/h2]
At the moment, we have more than 10 Isekai girls to be included in our first release. The races are various from Angel, Succubus, Mermaid to even Skeleton Girl. We are still looking for new unique ideas to add more girls to our collection. Don’t hesitate to comment your race fetish to us, it may show up in our next game update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38437256/76084553f2ba6a292847fff9ccde0527e002b66f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Room Designs[/h2]
We are reworking the room design to make it more stylish. Here are some concept arts which we are planning to make 3D version out of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38437256/800d45cc504a139bf65532f692a90dd1caadf89f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Game Mechanics[/h2]
Yup, here comes the fun part. Since this game is a simulation game focus on managing Tavern. We decide to divide the tasks of our beautiful employees into 4 categories: Food Serving, Material Hunting, Cleaning, and Night Service. Therefore, your job is to hire more girls and distribute them to the correct task in order to maximize the profit of the Tavern.

That’s all for today. See you in our next game update.
